purpose: Preserve the supplied developer-first guide content inside the canonical OMP reading shell used by tech-doc and write-plan; the shared helper remains the sole style authority.

retainedStructure: section#developer-queues with one nested section per developer
table.developer-queue: Queue, Ticket, Can land after, Delivery stage
concrete handoff narrative before the global table
table#dependency-overview: Order, Delivery, Direct prerequisites, Delivery stage, Execution mode, Developer
stage meanings and conditional safe-landing explanation
complete descriptions in native details/summary disclosures

originalGenerator.markdownImplementation: Python Markdown with fenced_code, tables and sane_lists extensions

canonicalShell.reason: The original bare main fragment loaded shared CSS but omitted the padded grid and Contents rail that the CSS expects. Preserve content structure, not that defective shell.

generalization.projectSpecificClaims: Supplied only by the input manifest and required complete Markdown descriptions/narratives, never inherited from the historical example.
generalization.developerCount: Any positive number; no fixed labels, names or staffing estimates.
generalization.identityPolicy: Stable graph IDs anchor full descriptions; optional displayId and URL show actual published identities without changing graph keys.
generalization.approvalIsolation: Read-only inputs and exclusive creation of a new Markdown/HTML pair; no tracker publication, approved-artifact overwrite or HTML-only approval mutation.
generalization.markdownHtmlParity: The same manifest, full Markdown source strings, computed graph ordering and narrative content produce both representations.
generalization.mermaidPolicy: Remain ordinary fenced code to avoid optional helper external tooling or runtime installs.

provenanceOnly: Historical source paths and hashes document extraction. They are not runtime dependencies and do not claim product implementation or verification has completed.
